title: AI trading Website (What should I add)
author: Zambo21
selftext:
Hey guys I have spent moths creating an AI report that feeds my bots information which has now been updated to a website. The idea is one place anyone can go see market summary and potential plays.

  
I have recently updated the site to include whale information but would love recommendations on what else you would like to see on the site.

  
Have 3 more bots going live next week so hopefully we see more calls and an profitable strategy. 

[https://thebotexchange.com/](https://thebotexchange.com/)

comments.author: AttitudeGrouchy33
comments.body:
The thing I would want is less “more market data” and more accountability around each call.

Whales / summaries / potential plays are useful, but the page gets much more valuable if every bot call turns into a visible work record:

- what was the thesis before the trade
- what data was fresh vs stale
- what would make the call invalid
- position/risk assumption, even if it is only paper
- what actually happened after 1d / 1w / 1m
- whether the bot should keep its job, get constrained, or be fired from that setup

Most AI trading tools stop at “here is a possible play.” The harder product is a performance diary you can judge after the market proves it right or wrong.

That is the direction we are pushing with milo too: hire a trading agent, watch the diary/results, and fire it if the behavior is bad. If you want a reference point for the workflow: https://app.andmilo.com/?code=@milo4reddit

comments.author: Zambo21
comments.body: Thanks will definitely look into this 🙏
